constraints.preserve_source: Do not embed, echo, or copy the source return into the wrapper. Keep the original output separately; source_execution_id and source_sha256 link the wrapper to that specific output.
constraints.source_fidelity: Original source is immutable and referenced by source_execution_id and canonical source_sha256; no source data is repeated in the wrapper except necessary correlation keys.
constraints.deterministic_derivations: A derived field is allowed only with an identified programmatically retrievable source and a reproducible script algorithm. Declaring a field in source JSON Schema is not proof that the data exists. If no collector can provide the required value, omit the key; do not guess or substitute a narrative.
constraints.missing_inputs: Unobserved facts are not set to null, zero, false, or empty collections; an output is omitted when its required source cannot be populated by an actual collection mechanism.
constraints.empty_collections: Derived zero counts are allowed for an explicitly observed empty collection; they do not prove observation completeness.
constraints.validation: Validate input against source JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, validate typed inputs for every derivation, and reject contradictory or unparseable data.
constraints.streams: Original verbatim base64 stream captures remain in source. Wrapper computes integrity, counts, and sizes; no stream truncation or text normalization.
constraints.workflow_identity: Treat each (repository, run_id, run_attempt) combination as distinct. Reattempts are separate records; never promote an intermediate outcome to a final one.
constraints.coverage: Unverified completeness declarations and counts of speculative causal relationships are excluded. Record source coverage only, without generating coverage summaries or inferred complete flags.
constraints.canonicalization: Source digest uses RFC 8785 canonical JSON; SHA-256 is encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.
constraints.authorization: This file documents enrichment only; it grants no execution, modification, or workflow authority.
constraints.non_duplication: A wrapper output field must be a new deterministic calculation or validation result absent from the source return. The sole exception is a source identifier necessary for correlating input and output, such as execution_id, run_id, run_attempt, job_id, process_record_id, stream_id, or record ID. Do not copy source values merely for convenience.

required_checks: JSON parses and version references the current agent-command-return.schema.json
All operation names are defined by a downstream deterministic evaluator before use; this JSON file is not an interpreter
Every derived key has a source pointer and a condition
Unresolved source facts never produce guessed output
Byte comparisons use decoded raw bytes and SHA-256
No additional processes, jobs, workflows, or files are invented
Source return is retained verbatim at the JSON-value level
No derived global completeness claim is emitted. Coverage observations remain source declarations only.
Each retained derivation includes a deterministic_population.source and a deterministic_population.script_algorithm specifying programmatic collection and computation.
Remove any output whose collector is not actually available at execution time; do not take the existence of source schema members as proof of observability.
All 31 retained derivations use deterministic scripts and do not duplicate recorded output fields except correlation identifiers.
Wrapper envelope references the source output by source_execution_id and source_sha256; it does not embed a second copy of the source.
Integrity outputs include only verified and the minimum source identifiers; original byte_length and sha256 are never repeated.

change_log.reason: Declared coverage statuses alone cannot establish global observational completeness; retain only source-supported deterministic enrichment.
Remove unsupported causal/coverage summarization and require an explicit scriptable source and computation for every remaining derived key.
Remove duplicate output-schema values while retaining correlation identifiers and new deterministic calculations.
